h1: Every important paper, found in seconds.
lead: Passports, ID cards, insurance policies, diplomas, warranties: each with its scans, who it belongs to and where the original is. Busy tells you before anything expires.

Passports four months ahead, the rest two months: enough time to renew without a rush.
Search inside your PDFs

faq: Where are my documents kept?
In a folder on your own computer (Documents/Busy/Home), as plain files. Nothing is uploaded to us.
Can I share it with my partner?
Put the folder in Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or iCloud Drive and open it on both computers.
Is it really free?
Yes. Busy Home is free, with no account and no subscription.

name: Contracts & Renewals
title: Contract renewal tracker: the last day to cancel
description: Insurance, energy, phone, the gym: what each costs a month and the last day to cancel before it renews by itself. A free reminder, private.
h1: Never miss the last day to cancel again.
lead: Everything the household pays for on a contract, what it costs a month, and the date that matters most: the last day to cancel before it renews by itself.
features: The last day to cancel
Worked out from the notice period, so you can decide in time.
What it all costs
Every contract per month, and the total for the household.
Keep, switch or cancel
A reminder weeks before the date, with the cancellation letter one click away.
Fixed term or rolling
Both kinds, each with the date that matters for it.
steps: Add your contracts
Insurance, energy, internet, phone, subscriptions, the gym.
Fill in the notice period
Busy works out the last day to cancel.
Decide in time
A nudge before the date, and the letter ready if you cancel.
faq: How does Busy know the last day to cancel?
From the end date or renewal date and the notice period you fill in. It shows the date and reminds you before it.
Does Busy cancel for me?
No. It writes the letter with your details filled in; you send it yourself.
Is anything sent online?
No. Your contracts stay in a folder on your own computer.
